expectations.text: States no: the February 2026 AT-C 105/205/210 exposure draft is a separate attestation-standards project
expectations.evidence: Short answer: no. The February 2026 AT-C exposure draft does not change the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria... Attestation standards exposure draft on AT-C 105, 205 and 210 (February 2026).

expectations.text: Gives its proposed effective date: June 15, 2029
Identifies the TSC refresh as the distinct October 2026 exposure draft
expectations.evidence: Proposed 2027 SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and Description Criteria (the TSC refresh) - Exposure draft issued October 28, 2026.

expectations.text: Confirms operative criteria remain the 2017 TSC with 2022 revised points of focus
expectations.evidence: Until the AICPA adopts a final TSC refresh, the 2017 TSC with the 2022 Revised Points of Focus are the operative criteria.

expectations.text: Distinguishes who owns what: criteria come from ASEC, attestation standards from the Auditing Standards Board
expectations.evidence: Attributes the TSC draft to ASEC, but never mentions the Auditing Standards Board as owner of the AT-C attestation standards.
